risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (335.2) indicates extreme market stress, rising DXY pressures real estate valuations, and earnings in 29 days adds event risk in a high-volatility environment.

debate.key_bear_argument: Pervasive bearish structure (price below all MAs, negative MACD, downside breakouts, stochastic bearish cross) combined with crisis-level VIX, inverted yield curve, earnings risk in 29 days, and zero institutional/insider conviction make this a high-risk fade of oversold conditions in a deteriorating macro environment.
